verdict.rationale: Canny's vendor pages say its Autopilot feature automatically captures feedback from support, sales and review platforms. They name sources across all three channels the story asks about: sales-call transcripts (Gong, Fathom, Fireflies), chat (Intercom, Slack) and support conversations, plus a way to send new conversations to Autopilot. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of how extraction and deduplication work, named support-ticketing integrations beyond the generic 'support platforms' claim, and independent or hands-on corroboration of capture accuracy.
